# Status 🌸

Repository: https://github.com/hudasol/scope-audit. Push status: not yet pushed.

## Data rung used

Rung 1. Real benchmark images with expert labels (BORROWED, Caltech Camera Traps) and the detector output released by LILA BC (PUBLISHED). Experiment A uses all benchmark events, experiment B a uniform working set of 8,000 events, and the demo uses 60 reduced images. Experiment C and the demo registry coordinates are SYNTHETIC. No UAE data were used.

## Predictions

- P1: held. Event level FOR below 3 percent at T of 0.2 (full benchmark, experiment A).
- P2: held. In the stress regime, M2 yield per 100 reviews is at least 1.5 times M0 at budgets 100 to 400.
- P3: MISSED. M1 yield is below 1.3 times M0 (budgets 100 to 400) and the ratio interval includes 1.0 for at least one budget.
- P4: held. M3 yield is within 10 percent of M2 (stress regime, budgets 100 to 400).
- P5: held. M2 mean error within 0.25 percentage points at budgets of 200 or more (stress regime).
- P6: MISSED. Wald plug in undercovers (below 93 percent) somewhere; smoothed or bootstrap intervals reach 93 to 97 percent at budgets 400 or more (M2, stress regime).
- P7: MISSED. Wilson with finite population correction covers 93 to 97 percent at budgets of 200 or more when FOR is at least 1 percent.
- P8: held. Identical inputs, configuration and seed give identical sample identifiers in 100 percent of runs.
- S1: held. P2 holds.
- S2: MISSED. The recommended estimator covers 93 to 97 percent (read as: a P6 named interval, M2, stress regime, budgets 400 and 800).
- S3: held. P5 holds.
- S4: held. P8 holds.
- S5: held. The claims lint passes.

## What works

- Engine, review log, export validation, integrity checks, privacy gate, claims lint and the three screen app, all covered by tests.
- Experiments A, B and C ran to completion with the pinned environment in ENVIRONMENT.md.

## What fell back

- No local detector inference: the published results file was ingested.
- Image features come from one frame per event.
- The headline interval was chosen after seeing calibration results (docs/DECISIONS.md entry 10).

## NOT RUN

- Any test on UAE data. A reviewer agreement study. A test of the detector on unseen data. Species classification. Operation at field scale. Deployment on Ministry infrastructure.

## Synthetic and borrowed items

- SYNTHETIC: experiment C pools, demo registry coordinates, unresolved shares in the app.
- BORROWED: all images and labels. PUBLISHED: detector confidences, Camtrap DP schemas.

## Unverified items
